title: Reject non-LF outer separators in PR2477's composed log comparison
body:
PR2477's held review demonstrates that replacing an outer-log LF with vertical tab is accepted through inherited `str.splitlines()`. This focused successor adds an outer-only guard for the eight extra Unicode separators, preserving LF/CRLF and mixed boundaries. All eleven vendor files, the203 predecessor negatives, raw-edge authentication and inner-log policy remain byte-identical. `CALLER-DELTA.patch` isolates the two caller-file changes.

**Evidence:** native Windows11 / CPython3.12.11 registered replay passed: normal archived grammar controls and optimized fresh historical1094 final stage (child assertions enabled),105 outputs,30 raw edges per side,6 inherited positives/203 negatives,8 parser counterexamples and1 new positive/129 grammar negatives. Metadata/pins and committed-byte/source-history preflight pass. Separate AI source review found no blocking issue. Exact head: `f868287c92aabd6221120cb3df9d7550eca338bd`.

**Scope:** historical1094 final-stage composition using authenticated archived ancestor inputs; not current6030, cold ancestry, hosted CI, independent human acceptance or a new bound. Decimal timing spellings remain unchanged. POSIX executable-mode preflight was unavailable on this Windows host. The pending PR2477 commit is retained as a history parent for reproducible source pins; the diff against current main contains only this new package. No upstream PR is merged or closed.

Reproduce:
```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-windows-lf-grammar
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/selected-windows-lf-grammar --check-source-history
```
Use writable TEMP/TMP on sandboxed Windows. See `VALIDATION.json`, `PROOF.md`, and the [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1472#discussioncomment-19283537).
